external_research.title: Causal Interventions on Continuous Variables: A Case Study on Verb Bias in Steering Vectors for In-Context Learning
external_research.authors: Zhenghao Herbert Zhou, R. Thomas McCoy, Robert Frank
external_research.source_direct_finding: Counterfactual edits along a learned continuous verb-bias direction causally shifted downstream structural preferences, while other steering-vector components encoded error signals associated with in-context learning but those error-signal aspects were not causally used in downstream production.
external_research.project_implication: Trigger-2 must distinguish representation/decodability and even intervention responsiveness from evidence that a candidate signal is actually consumed by the downstream cognitive update path. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY; this is not Clay/Qwen-specific runtime evidence.

research_gap.existing_v18_law: Decoded/separable representation is not causal control; exact intervention efficacy and off-target controls are required.
research_gap.new_missing_distinction: A signal can be present in, or associated with, a steerable representation while the hypothesized downstream update mechanism does not consume that signal. Therefore causal representation/control evidence and causal utilization-by-update evidence are separate promotion gates.
research_gap.why_nonduplicate: This extends the existing READ-versus-WRITE/actionability gate with a mediation/utilization question: did the manipulated state become an input to the intended update computation, rather than merely co-varying with or locally steering a representation?

level_0_encoded_or_decodable.meaning: The candidate variable can be decoded or is measurably represented.

level_1_counterfactually_steerable.meaning: An exact-site intervention changes the candidate variable or a matched downstream readout under controls.

level_2_update_path_utilized.meaning: The candidate variable is demonstrably consumed by the intended downstream state/evidence/update computation under mediation, lesion or path-specific controls.

level_3_behaviorally_functional.meaning: The update-path effect produces the preregistered task/trajectory consequence while preserving off-target retention and authority boundaries.

hypothesis: For Global J-Space/Hyperposition, the strongest trainable causal target is not merely a decodable or steerable vector state but a state whose manipulated semantic content is demonstrably consumed by the intended update computation and then changes the correct recurrent trajectory.
counterhypothesis: If an intervention on the candidate J-Space direction reliably changes an immediate downstream readout, separate utilization/mediation tests are redundant.
counterhypothesis_reason: The external causal-intervention result provides a concrete mechanism class in which information is encoded without being causally used by the hypothesized downstream behavior. Immediate readout movement therefore cannot by itself establish update-path use.

required_after_existing_actionability_an: freeze exact model checkpoint tokenizer runtime layer site vector/subspace and intervention magnitude before holdout inspection
define the intended downstream update variable or state transition independently of the intervention readout
show that candidate-state intervention changes the intended update state in the preregistered direction under matched null same-norm orthogonal or shuffled controls
lesion or block the hypothesized candidate-to-update path and require the intervention effect on the update state to collapse when the mechanism predicts collapse
where a separable path is available perform rescue by restoring the candidate signal or downstream mediator and require predicted recovery
test an encoded-but-nonutilized positive control or synthetic analogue where decodability is preserved but update-path use is intentionally absent so the gate cannot collapse to probe accuracy
report off-target damage and protocol authority retention separately from target effect
require held-out family/context transfer and combine with the existing bucketed worst-region guard rather than mean-only acceptance
do not transfer raw activation coordinates or causal credit across model checkpoint layer runtime or site identities

training_implication.positive_label_rule: Do not create a positive J-Space UPDATE_USED label from decodability, correlation, local steering, self-report, recurrence, or aggregate intervention success alone.
training_implication.hard_negative_design_candidate: Paired cases should eventually include DECODED_NOT_USED, STEERED_NOT_UPDATE_MEDIATED, UPDATE_MEDIATED_BUT_BEHAVIOR_WRONG, and UPDATE_MEDIATED_BEHAVIOR_CORRECT states, but no rows are admitted by this delta.
training_implication.curriculum_relation: READ, BIND_ROUTE and WRITE remain useful channel diagnostics; causal utilization adds a mechanism-composition gate between WRITE/control and end-to-end recurrent functional promotion.

artifact_lifecycle_delta.revision_reason: No contradiction. This delta extends v18 causal actionability with explicit downstream utilization/mediation separation; accepted data and credits remain unchanged.
READ/decode versus WRITE/control remains valid; this delta adds the distinct question of whether the target update computation actually consumes the candidate signal.
Bucketed fidelity and restricted alignment remain valid and should be composed with the utilization gate.
This research delta does not repair the existing conditional/model-visible nuisance leakage.
